Creative Analytics Digest (last 3 months): We reviewed 34 ads across 1 objective segment.

Sales:  
Winning ads featured copy like "biba's_biggest_sale_is_here_biba's_biggest_sale_of_the_year_is_your_cue_to_shop," which outperformed the Sales average by 73% on performance index, with ROAS nearly 122% above benchmark and CPA 53% lower. Other strong performers used discount-led hooks and discount offers, with colors black, purple, and playful moods also driving better results.  
Losing ads often had aspirational hooks and copy focused on plus-size styles, underperforming by over 27% on performance index, with ROAS around 18% below benchmark and CPA nearly 20% higher. Ads with delivery map visuals and silent audio also lagged behind.  
The strongest cross-crystal combo combined discount_lead hooks with discount offers, boosting performance by 163% over average.
